acceptance: Dependency governance passes before implementation admission: interprocess is pinned exactly at 2.4.4 with default features disabled and an explicit reviewed license/dependency evidence packet; serde_json remains pinned at 1.0.151 and its approval scope/purpose exactly matches dev+runtime use; the repository dependency validator and Provenance job pass.

kernuxd exists as a Rust workspace library/binary with deterministic start, serving, shutting-down, and stopped lifecycle behavior; the crate contains no TCP/UDP/HTTP listener path and no remote-network bind.

The local transport is cross-platform by construction: Unix uses a filesystem Unix-domain socket under a private endpoint directory and Windows uses a local named pipe. Unix permission and stale-path rules fail closed; Windows remote-host pipe names are rejected. No caller-authentication claim is made.

The reusable daemon probe wire contract is derived from the authoritative KRP schema and deterministic generator, is additive without changing existing KRP v1 object meanings, binds exact krp/1 semantics, updates required schema-digest derivatives, and passes shared Rust/TypeScript conformance/drift checks.

Control framing is bounded and fail-closed: at most one probe request per connection, a fixed documented maximum frame size, finite receive/send timeouts, malformed/oversized/unknown-field/unsupported-version inputs rejected, and no implicit downgrade or authority inference.

A successful probe returns honest daemon health plus daemon build/version and KRP contract/provenance metadata; probe success does not imply caller authorization, privileged-operation readiness, persistence readiness, or P02 phase completion.

Graceful shutdown is owner-controlled rather than IPC-authorized: shutdown stops new accepts, bounds completion of active probes, releases the local endpoint, reaches stopped state, and permits clean restart. No unauthenticated shutdown-over-IPC surface exists.

Executable tests prove startup/probe/shutdown/restart, second-bind conflict, safe stale endpoint recovery and unsafe-path rejection, timeout/oversize/malformed/version-mismatch rejection, endpoint cleanup, and an explicit no-network-listener invariant.

Unix behavior is exercised by the normal Rust/local test path and Windows named-pipe behavior is exercised by a dedicated Windows GitHub Actions job. The original five protected contexts remain required and unchanged; the additional Windows job is evidence, not a substitute.

The implementation contains no KX-P02-S01-T02 caller/session binding, no identity/keys, no durable store, no artifact CAS, no policy/grant engine, no secret broker, no privileged host-operation implementation, and no remote transport.

The exact implementation candidate passes git diff --check, full pnpm check, Diffcipline R3, OpenCodeReview-assisted exact-range review with complete manual accounting for excluded files, the five protected exact-head checks, and the additional Windows evidence job.
After native SpecGrain proof and protected closeout merge, KX-P02-S01-T01 becomes PROVEN and only KX-P02-S01-T02 becomes NEXT; later P02 tasks remain PLANNED and P02 phase exit remains unproven.

minimality.rationale: Use the existing Rust workspace, generated KRP contracts, SpecGrain/Diffcipline/provenance gates, serde_json pin, and a single synchronous cross-platform local-socket dependency. Do not add an async runtime, web server, database, authentication subsystem, or separate protocol stack.

requirements: T01 must never convert transport reachability or probe success into caller authorization or privileged authority.
No unauthenticated IPC shutdown command is permitted before KX-P02-S01-T02 binds caller sessions.
Unix stale-endpoint cleanup must never unlink an arbitrary non-socket path, and transport code must not bind any TCP/UDP/network endpoint.
Windows named-pipe behavior requires Windows CI evidence; a non-Windows cross-compile alone cannot close that acceptance criterion.

outcome: Establish the first privileged Kernux daemon executable and library with a bounded lifecycle, non-network local IPC foundation that maps to Unix-domain sockets on Unix and local named pipes on Windows, generated KRP health/version probe contracts, fail-closed framing, and graceful owner-controlled shutdown, while explicitly deferring caller authentication/session binding to KX-P02-S01-T02.
rationale: P01 is PROVEN and KX-P02-S01-T01 is the only authorized P02 frontier. The first kernel slice must create a real cross-platform daemon and private local transport without preempting the next task that binds launch nonce and peer identity, and without introducing persistence, policy, secrets, process control, or remote networking.

risk.recovery: Revert the bounded P02-S01-T01 refinement/implementation/closeout changes, remove the kernuxd workspace member and any newly admitted direct dependency entries, restore generated KRP derivatives to the prior qualified schema, and keep KX-P02-S01-T01 at NEXT. No later P02 authority is created by this Grain.

scope_in: Create a Rust workspace crate and binary named kernuxd that owns the daemon lifecycle boundary but does not yet implement privileged host operations.

Use synchronous interprocess 2.4.4 local sockets with default features disabled as the bounded transport dependency, mapping to Unix-domain sockets on Unix and local Windows named pipes on Windows; do not add Tokio or a TCP listener.

Add a governed dependency-admission packet before manifest use for interprocess 2.4.4 with observed license expression 0BSD OR Apache-2.0, and expand the existing exact serde_json 1.0.151 approval from dev to dev+runtime only for bounded daemon control-frame encoding/decoding.

Use an explicit Unix filesystem socket endpoint rooted in a caller-supplied or Kernux-owned private runtime directory; create/verify private directory and socket permissions, reject unsafe pre-existing non-socket paths, and reclaim only a verified stale socket owned by the daemon endpoint policy.
Use only local Windows named-pipe names; reject remote-host pipe forms. Do not claim caller authentication, authorization, or peer binding in this task.

Introduce the minimal reusable daemon health/version probe wire types through the existing authoritative KRP schema and deterministic Rust/TypeScript generation path rather than hand-maintaining divergent public wire structs. Existing KRP v1 object meanings must remain unchanged.

Implement a bounded single-request local control frame using generated probe types, exact krp/1 contract metadata, a strict maximum frame size, bounded receive/send timeouts, structured fail-closed errors, and no permissive unknown-field or version fallback.

Expose a read-only health/version probe that reports daemon lifecycle health plus daemon build/version and KRP contract/provenance metadata without granting authority or implying downstream runtime readiness.

Implement graceful owner-controlled shutdown through an in-process daemon shutdown handle/state machine: stop accepting new work, allow or bound any active probe completion, release/reclaim the endpoint, and join cleanly. Do not expose shutdown-over-IPC before KX-P02-S01-T02 binds callers.

Prove endpoint collision behavior, safe stale-endpoint handling, malformed/oversized/version-mismatch rejection, bounded idle-client behavior, health/version success, graceful shutdown cleanup, restart after shutdown, and absence of network listeners.

Add a Windows CI evidence job that compiles and runs the Windows-relevant kernuxd tests on a Windows runner while preserving the existing five protected status contexts unchanged; Unix runtime tests must run on the normal Rust path and local qualification.
Preserve exact dependency governance, provenance checks, generated-contract drift checks, P01 compatibility/adversarial gates, and all existing protected checks.
After native verification and protected closeout, mark only KX-P02-S01-T01 PROVEN and advance only KX-P02-S01-T02 to NEXT.
scope_out: Do not implement launch nonce, peer identity binding, caller authentication, caller authorization, credential checks, or rejection of unauthorized local callers; KX-P02-S01-T02 owns those semantics.
Do not expose a shutdown command over unauthenticated IPC in T01; graceful shutdown is owner-controlled until caller binding exists.

Do not implement installation/device identity, key generation/rotation/recovery, SQLite or other durable metadata storage, artifact CAS, policy evaluation, Grant issuance/enforcement, permission profiles, secret brokering, security audit persistence, or any later P02 task.
Do not implement filesystem/process/PTY privileged operations, sandbox lifecycle, browser/computer control, remote transport, cloud transport, HTTP, TCP, UDP, or network listeners.
Do not alter existing KRP v1 field meanings, loosen closed decoding, introduce implicit version downgrade, or treat daemon/application version as protocol authority.
Do not claim Windows named-pipe runtime proof from a non-Windows compile alone; Windows behavior requires the dedicated Windows CI evidence path.
Do not mark P02 phase exit or any later P02 task PROVEN through this Grain.
title: KX-P02-S01-T01 — Create kernuxd lifecycle, private local transport, health/version probe, and graceful shutdown
